metadata.access_scope: public search and publicly readable pages only
metadata.quality_note: Claims are source-linked and confidence-scored; processes vary by role, level, team and location.

sources.title: Meta Software Engineer Interview Experience - India

reports.summary: Reported loops commonly contain phone coding, multiple coding rounds, design and behavioral rounds.
Candidate reports emphasize test cases, reasoning and dry runs before coding.
One India-specific report describes coding, technical and managerial rounds.

evidence.claim: Multiple coding rounds plus system design and behavioral evaluation
Speed, correctness, articulation, test cases and trade-offs matter
Coding reports include graph, tree and array problems

sources.title: Google Interview Experience for Software Engineer (SDE-2) 2025
Google Software Engineer, University Graduate, 2026 - India
Google Software Engineer Interview Experience - India

reports.summary: Five-round process: phone screening, three technical onsite rounds and one behavioral round.
Two rounds combined DSA and Googleyness/behavioral discussion.
Reported topics include arrays, BFS, DP, greedy/hash-map and DFS.

evidence.claim: India SDE-2 evidence shows one phone screen, three technical rounds and one behavioral round
DSA topics include arrays, graphs, BFS, DFS, DP and greedy techniques
Candidates are expected to explain their approach before and during coding

sources.title: AI Engineer Interview Questions: Sarvam AI
My interview experience with SarvamAI for ML engineer role

reports.summary: Public compilation describes practical proof-of-work, technical deep dives, occasional DSA/fundamentals, and founder/CTO or HR conversations.
Small public sample includes project assessment, resume/DSA and founder discussion.
Candidate reports a proctored VAD build followed by ASR/VAD/LLM and speech-model discussion.

evidence.claim: Sarvam appears proof-of-work oriented rather than purely LeetCode oriented
A candidate reported building a VAD from scratch in a timed practical assessment
Project assessment, technical/DSA discussion and founder/HR rounds appear in public reports
